# Block `info`

**Use:** A callout: a note, an insight, a warning or a common pitfall the learner should not miss.

**Avoid:** Ordinary explanation; more than one callout in a row.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "info",
  "variant": "pitfall",
  "title": "Correlation is not causation",
  "md": "Two variables moving together does not show that one causes the other.",
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"info"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `variant` | `"note"` \| `"insight"` \| `"warning"` \| `"pitfall"` | yes |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `md` | string | yes |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
